PR2.notes: prefix rows equal the full-trace rows of the same nodes within tolerance

PR3.notes: closed-form A_0 equals the attention-detached rows within tolerance

interpretations.PR1_kill: kill if any relative error exceeds the tolerance of the dtype in use (one dtype is run; the 'fails in both dtypes' clause needs a bf16 rerun, which Dawar decides on); a time-ratio failure alone is 'fail'
interpretations.PR1_rel_err: per mix: ||Y_mix - phi_mix A||_2 / ||phi_mix A||_2 over all source columns, phi A summed in float64 from one-hot rows; the status uses the maximum
interpretations.PR1_timing: same operator and batch shape: a batch of B dense random-sign seeds over all targets against a batch of B one-hot seeds; median of timing_repeats after one warm-up; ratio = mixed / one-hot
interpretations.PR2: feature targets only (logit rows depend on the last position); sources aligned by (kind, layer, position, feature id); a prefix target missing from the full trace, or any mass on sources that exist only in the full trace, counts as a mismatch
interpretations.PR3_tolerance: 1e-4 in fp32 and fp64; the PR1/PR2 bf16 tolerance (2e-2) if the model runs in bf16
interpretations.PR3_rows: every row (logits and features) of the attention-detached pass against A_0 (Frobenius)
interpretations.PR3_s95: reduction factor = energy-weighted median column s95 of A over that of A - A_0 (feature targets, squared version; the absolute version is reported too); the informative flag uses the squared version and the median over every (set, prompt)
interpretations.PR5_hub: hub = remainder column with absolute s95 > 0.1 of its causal set
interpretations.PR6_T: T in 'm <= T/10' and 'm <= T/4' is the number of feature targets of the prompt (logit rows are computed exactly, not sensed)
interpretations.PR6_seeds: fidelity at (prompt, m, decoder) needs >= 2 of 3 seeds (prereg fidelity.seeds_required)
interpretations.epsilon_run_error: energy-weighted per-column error of a run = sum_s w_s e_s / sum_s w_s with w_s the squared norm of the remainder column (feature targets), e_s its relative error; energy-weighted median and 90% energy quantile are stored as alternatives
interpretations.k_eff_short: median over the 3 Qwen short prompts of the per-prompt energy-weighted median remainder absolute s95 (entries, feature targets)
